tasks.label: cmake: build test binaries only
tasks.command: cmake -B _build -G "Unix Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build _build --target unit_tests trust trust-dap trust-lsp generate_lit_cfg_py

tasks.label: test: all (run all via ctest)
tasks.command: for b in _build/unit_tests _build/trust _build/trust-dap _build/trust-lsp; do [ -x "$b" ] || { cmake --build _build --target unit_tests trust trust-dap trust-lsp generate_lit_cfg_py; break; }; done; /usr/local/bin/ctest --test-dir _build --output-on-failure -Q

tasks.label: test: all verbose (full output)
tasks.command: for b in _build/unit_tests _build/trust _build/trust-dap _build/trust-lsp; do [ -x "$b" ] || { cmake --build _build --target unit_tests trust trust-dap trust-lsp generate_lit_cfg_py; break; }; done; /usr/local/bin/ctest --test-dir _build --output-on-failure
